fragrances.name: Light Blue
fragrances.description: A breezy Mediterranean citrus with crisp green apple over clean cedar and musk, like a sunny afternoon on a Sicilian beach. Light and uncomplicated, it is a staple for holidays and hot days.
cons: Very common, you will smell it on others

fragrances.name: Light Blue Pour Homme
fragrances.description: Tangy grapefruit and juniper with a pinch of pepper and rosemary, drying down to a clean, lightly woody musk. A no-fuss seaside citrus that feels like diving into cold water.
pros: Very easy to wear in heat

fragrances.name: Acqua di Giò
fragrances.description: The archetypal fresh marine scent: citrus, sea spray and a soft floral-woody base that evoke a sun-bleached Mediterranean coastline. Clean, relaxed and endlessly wearable in warm weather.

fragrances.name: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A sparkling yuzu-citrus aquatic warmed by subtle spice and a woody backbone. It stays crisp and energetic in the heat while carrying more character than most blue scents.
pros: Good performance for a fresh scent

fragrances.name: L'Eau d'Issey
fragrances.description: Watery lotus and airy florals with a hint of melon, like fresh flowers on a rain-cooled terrace. Transparent and serene, it stays composed even in high heat.
cons: Melon-ozonic opening feels dated to some
Can come across sharp or soapy

fragrances.name: Versace Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A bright, clean citrus-aromatic with neroli and a soft floral heart over tonka and musk. Polished and uncontroversial, it feels like a crisp white shirt on a sunny day.

fragrances.name: Bright Crystal
fragrances.description: Tart pomegranate and a squeeze of yuzu over soft peony and magnolia, settling into a clean, gently sweet musk. Pretty and uncomplicated, it suits carefree daytime summer wear.
pros: Pretty and very easy to like
cons: A little sweet in extreme heat

fragrances.name: Cool Water
fragrances.description: The late-80s blueprint for fresh aquatics: cool mint, lavender and sea air over a mossy, musky base. Brisk and invigorating on a hot day.

fragrances.name: Nautica Voyage
fragrances.description: A crisp green-apple and watery-lotus freshness over light woods and musk. Simple, clean and inexpensive enough to spray generously in the heat.

fragrances.name: CK One
fragrances.description: A shareable citrus and green-tea freshness with a soft, clean-skin musk that defined 90s minimalism. Easygoing and relaxed, ideal for hot, casual days.

fragrances.name: Green Tea
fragrances.description: Zesty lemon and mint over a green tea accord, like a glass of iced tea on a scorching afternoon. Cheap, cheerful and made for splashing on liberally.

fragrances.name: Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune
fragrances.description: A tart, juicy pink grapefruit sharpened with blackcurrant and softened by a touch of patchouli and vanilla. Vivid and grown-up, it is a citrus with real presence.
pros: Lasts better than most citrus scents
cons: Grapefruit-cassis facet reads sweaty to some

fragrances.name: Chance Eau Fraîche
fragrances.description: A crisp, citrusy take on the Chance line with water hyacinth and pink pepper over clean woods and patchouli. Sleek and energetic, it feels chic in summer heat without going sugary.

fragrances.name: Eau Sauvage
fragrances.description: A refined, herbal citrus of lemon and basil with a luminous jasmine glow over vetiver and moss. Understated elegance that has defined the gentleman's summer cologne for decades.

fragrances.name: Colonia
fragrances.description: A classic Italian cologne of sunny citrus, lavender and rosemary resting on soft woods. It evokes pressed linen and cafe terraces on the Amalfi coast.

fragrances.name: Orange Sanguine
fragrances.description: A vivid, juicy blood-orange accord with a whisper of jasmine and warm woods beneath. Pure bottled sunshine that lifts the mood on a hot morning.
cons: Premium price for a simple citrus

fragrances.name: Aqua Universalis
fragrances.description: A crystalline citrus and white-flower freshness on a soft musk base, evoking crisp linen drying in the sun. Clean, bright and quietly luxurious.
cons: Very expensive for a clean scent

fragrances.name: Virgin Island Water
fragrances.description: Lime, coconut and a splash of white rum over tropical florals, like a beach cocktail served in a bottle. Carefree and sunny, it channels island holidays.

fragrances.name: Neroli Portofino
fragrances.description: Bright bergamot and lemon meet neroli and orange blossom, with rosemary and lavender adding a crisp herbal edge over a soft ambery finish. Tailored and upbeat, it suits dressy lunches by the water.
pros: Polished enough for dressy summer events
cons: Longevity does not match the price

fragrances.name: Soleil Blanc
fragrances.description: Creamy coconut, tuberose and ylang-ylang wrapped in warm amber, with a flicker of cardamom and pistachio up top. It smells like expensive tanning oil at a beach club, rich and sensual enough for sunset drinks by the sea.
cons: Can feel heavy in extreme humidity

fragrances.name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
fragrances.description: Salt-air and dry sage over a soft ambrette musk, reading more like a cool coastal breeze than a perfume. Unsweetened and airy, it stays comfortable in sticky humidity.

fragrances.name: Philosykos Eau de Toilette
fragrances.description: Snappy fig leaf and sappy greenery settle into soft, faintly coconutty fig flesh and a dry cedar base. Natural and shade-cool, it smells like an orchard at midday rather than a bowl of fruit.
cons: Milky fig note is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Un Jardin sur le Nil
fragrances.description: Tart green mango and grapefruit brightness with lotus, reeds and a faint thread of incense. Airy and watercolor-like, it feels cooling in both dry and humid heat.

fragrances.name: Afternoon Swim
fragrances.description: A radiant burst of mandarin, bergamot and sweet orange with a zing of ginger over a salty ambergris base. Joyful and sunlit, and more tenacious than most citrus scents.

fragrances.name: Replica Beach Walk
fragrances.description: A soft beachy blend of bergamot, coconut milk and ylang over musk, recalling sunscreen on warm skin during a stroll along the shore. Light, carefree and pleasantly nostalgic.
pros: Light coconut that avoids gourmand heaviness
cons: Sunscreen association is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Eau d'Orange Verte
fragrances.description: A tart green-orange cologne with a snap of mint and blackcurrant leaf over a light mossy base. Bracing and timeless, it is pure refreshment on a hot afternoon.
pros: Tart green orange with herbal snap
cons: Mossy base feels old-fashioned to some

fragrances.name: Le Beau
fragrances.description: A playful coconut-and-tonka scent with a bright bergamot lift, evoking a beach bar at sunset. Sweeter and louder than typical summer freshies, it is made for fun rather than the office.
cons: Sweetness can feel heavy in humidity

fragrances.name: Aqva Pour Homme
fragrances.description: A marine-mineral freshness of citrus and seaweed that evokes sea spray on sun-baked Mediterranean rocks. Cool, clean and at its best in blazing heat.
